title: Depictions of Depression in Generative AI Video Models: A Preliminary Study of OpenAI’s Sora 2

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative coding of narrative arcs (recovery vs. stasis/deterioration) and quantitative analysis of visual aesthetics, audio, and semantic features in videos generated with the prompt 'Depression' to identify stereotypical visual tropes and platform-mediated 'recovery bias'.
Qualitative coding of the apparent gender of human figures in generated videos to measure demographic skews across different access points (App vs. API) for the 'Depression' prompt.

Qualitative coding estimating the age (by decade) of human figures in generated videos to assess whether the model disproportionately stereotypes specific age groups (e.g., young adults) as experiencing depression.
